title: Exam Orientation and How to Study

header.html: Exam overview, domain map and answer technique (all domains)
Know the exam format, scoring and response types; know the four domains and their weights; use a repeatable method to answer every question
the official AWS Developer Associate (DVA-C03) exam guide

toc.title: What the exam does not test

html:
1The exam at a glance

Item Fact
Scored questions 50
Unscored questions 15, not marked on the exam, so treat every question as scored
Response types Multiple choice (one correct, three distractors) and multiple response (two or more correct out of five or more; all must be selected)
Passing score 720 on a scale of 100 to 1,000
Scoring model Compensatory: you pass the exam as a whole, not each domain
Guessing No penalty; unanswered questions count as wrong
Target candidate One or more years developing and maintaining applications on AWS

Old wording The older exam is DVA-C02 (last day November 30, 2026). DVA-C03 is used from December 1, 2026. It adds AI-assisted development, managed AI services and securing AI services.

Exam tip

. On a multiple response question the stem says how many to choose (for example "Choose TWO"). You get credit only if you select all the correct options, so read the number first.

2The four domains

Domain Weight Tasks
1. Development with AWS Services 30% Code for hosted applications; Lambda; data stores
2. Security 26% Authentication and authorization; encryption and sensitive data; securing AI services
3. Testing and Deployment 22% Artifacts; testing; CI/CD deployment
4. Troubleshooting and Optimization 22% Root cause analysis; logging and observability; optimization
Exam tip

. Domain 1 plus Domain 2 is 56%. Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, IAM, KMS and Cognito appear again and again.

3What the exam does not test

The guide lists job tasks that are out of scope: designing architectures, designing CI/CD pipelines, administering IAM users and groups, administering servers, selecting foundation models, prompt engineering and RAG design, AI governance, ETL design and network design. Services such as Amazon Polly, Rekognition, SageMaker AI and Strands Agents are out of scope.

4How to answer every question

  1. Read the last line (what is asked, how many answers).
  2. Underline the constraint: cheapest, least operational overhead, most secure, lowest latency, no code change.
  3. Eliminate options that break the constraint or use an out-of-scope idea.
  4. Choose the option that uses the managed AWS feature designed for the job.
  5. Never leave a blank.

Developer-exam habits: prefer IAM roles to access keys, Secrets Manager or Parameter Store to hard-coded secrets, SQS or SNS or EventBridge to tight coupling, and retry with backoff to immediate retry loops.

5A four-week study plan

Week Modules Goal
1 1 to 4 Integration, resilience, SDKs, AI-assisted development
2 5 to 7 Lambda, DynamoDB, data stores and caching
3 8 to 10 and 11 to 13 Security, artifacts, testing, CI/CD
4 14 to 16 Troubleshooting, optimization, mixed practice

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1What is the minimum passing score on the DVA-C03 exam?

  • A700
  • B720
  • C750
  • D800
Show the answer

Answer: B. The minimum passing score is 720 on a scale of 100 to 1,000.

S2A candidate does not know an answer. What should the candidate do?

  • ALeave it blank, because wrong answers lose points
  • BAnswer it only if the question is multiple response
  • CAnswer it, because there is no penalty for guessing
  • DSkip it, because it is probably unscored
Show the answer

Answer: C. Unanswered questions are scored as incorrect and there is no guessing penalty.

S3What is required to earn credit on a multiple response question?

  • ASelect at least one correct option
  • BSelect the first two options
  • CSelect any option except the distractors
  • DSelect all the correct options
Show the answer

Answer: D. All correct responses must be selected to receive credit.

S4Which two domains together carry 56 percent of the scored content?

  • ASecurity and Testing and Deployment
  • BDevelopment with AWS Services and Security
  • CTesting and Deployment and Troubleshooting and Optimization
  • DDevelopment with AWS Services and Troubleshooting and Optimization
Show the answer

Answer: B. Development with AWS Services is 30 percent and Security is 26 percent.

6.2 Recall questions

R1How many questions are scored?

Show the answer

50 (plus 15 unscored questions that are not identified).

R2What does "compensatory" scoring mean?

Show the answer

You must pass the exam as a whole, not each domain.

R3Name the four domains.

Show the answer

Development with AWS Services; Security; Testing and Deployment; Troubleshooting and Optimization.

R4Which exam does DVA-C03 replace, and from when?

Show the answer

DVA-C02, from December 1, 2026.

R5What is new in DVA-C03?

Show the answer

AI-assisted development, managed AI services and securing AI services.

R6Name one job task that is out of scope.

Show the answer

For example designing architectures, administering IAM users, or selecting foundation models.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Format 50 scored + 15 unscored; multiple choice and multiple response; 720 to pass; no guessing penalty
Domains 30 / 26 / 22 / 22 percent
New in C03 AI-assisted development, managed AI services, AI security
Method read the last line, find the constraint, eliminate, pick the managed feature
